name: session-launcher
description: /fs [folder] starts a fresh Remote Control session in auto mode, in this folder or another, from any device

launcher.title: Where to start the session
launcher.description: terminal: a new terminal window running claude (see kind). desktop: the desktop app's new-session screen for the folder, with terminal as the fallback and always from a remote device. both: the two.

kind.title: Session kind
kind.description: server: `claude remote-control --permission-mode auto`, a fresh session plus a server that starts more from your phone or claude.ai/code. interactive: `claude --permission-mode auto --remote-control`, one session you can also use in the window.

roots.title: Project roots
roots.description: Extra folders, separated by ';', searched for a folder name given to /fs. The current folder and its parent are always searched.
